title: Intelligent Identification and Repair of Design Defects in BIM via Domain-Specific Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.28629v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing methods lack a generalized approach to efficiently identify and resolve the diversity of design defects in BIM. Therefore, this study proposes an integrated framework to identify and repair various defects in BIM via domain-specific LLMs. Firstly, a BIM-to-Text method with component-balanced chunking is introduced to bridge BIM data with LLMs. Then, prompt learning with rule injection, few-shot prompting and RAG is proposed to identify defects and generate repair suggestions. Meanwhile, a hallucination control strategy combining key identifier validation and token-length thresholds is introduced to ensure reliability. Experiments show capability expansion yields 85% identification accuracy versus 70% for traditional rule checking, achieving a 94% rate of reasonable repair suggestions. translated_title: 基于领域特定大语言模型的BIM设计缺陷智能识别与修复
translated_abstract: 现有方法缺乏一种通用方法来高效识别和解决BIM中多样化的设计缺陷。因此，本研究提出了一个集成框架，利用领域特定大语言模型（LLM）来识别和修复BIM中的各类缺陷。首先，引入了一种具有构件均衡分块的BIM-to-Text方法，以连接BIM数据与大语言模型。然后，提出了结合规则注入、少样本提示和检索增强生成（RAG）的提示学习方法，用于识别缺陷并生成修复建议。同时，引入了一种结合关键标识符验证与token长度阈值的幻觉控制策略，以确保可靠性。实验表明，能力扩展使识别准确率达到85%，而传统规则检查仅为70%，合理修复建议率达到94%。此外，所提出的幻觉控制策略进一步将准确率从64%提升至85%，在单次干预中消除了92.5%的幻觉。
tldr: 本研究提出基于领域特定大语言模型的集成框架，通过构件均衡的BIM-to-Text转换、结合规则注入与RAG的提示学习以及幻觉控制策略，将BIM设计缺陷识别准确率提升至85%，合理修复建议率达94%。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an integrated framework based on domain-specific LLMs, combining component-balanced BIM-to-Text conversion, prompt learning with rule injection and RAG, and hallucination control strategies, achieving 85% defect identification accuracy and a 94% rate of reasonable repair suggestions for BIM design defects.
